question: Arun and Manish can complete a task in 15 days. Manish and Tarun can complete the same task in 12 days, and Tarun and Arun can complete the same task in 10 days. Find the time taken by Arun to complete the same task alone.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

(A+M)=1/15, (M+T)=1/12, (T+A)=1/10

Add ⇒ 2(A+M+T)=1/4 ⇒ A+M+T=1/8

A = 1/8 − 1/12 = 1/24

Time = 24 days

**∴ Answer = 24 days**
